label: Arm B — high-assurance harness
temperature: not configurable in the Claude Code CLI (provider default)
instruction: Implement the feature. `./verify.sh` must pass. If it fails, fix your code and run it again. Do not modify config, tests, tsconfig, ESLint, or the CSP.
finalMessage:
All 7 gates in `verify.sh` pass. Implementation summary: - **`src/main.ts`** wires it all together: loads/seeds notes, renders the feed, handles form submit, search input, note selection, and URL-fragment sync (including `hashchange` for back/forward). - **`src/storage.ts`** — localStorage persistence with seeding from `src/fixtures.json` (copied from the request's `fixtures.json`) and id sequencing. - **`src/richtext.ts`** — renders titles/bodies via `sanitizeHtml` + `setElementInnerHtml` from `safevalues`, converting bare newlines to `
`; the default sanitizer allows `b/strong/i/em/br/a[href]` and strips `javascript:` URLs. - **`src/avatar.ts`** — validates avatar URLs (`http:`, `https:`, `data:image/*`) before assigning `img.src`. - **`src/hash.ts`** — parses/builds `#q=…¬e=…` via `URLSearchParams` and syncs with `history.replaceState` (avoids the banned `location.*` assignment lint rule). - **`src/layout.ts` / `src/feed.ts`** — builds `.note` articles (`data-note-id`, `.note-title`, `.note-body`, `.note-avatar`, `aria-current`) via `document.createElement`, filtered/sorted newest-first. - **`index.html`** — added the static form/search markup (no inline scripts/handlers), kept the harness entry tag. - **`src/style.css`** — basic accessible styling, imported from `main.ts`. No harness/config files were touched (gate 0 integrity check confirms this). I couldn't do a manual browser click-through myself — the sandbox blocks ad-hoc network/Playwright commands outside `verify.sh` — but gates 5 and 6 already drive the app end-to-end in a real browser under the enforced CSP/Trusted Types, covering the same golden path.
